prompt: Someone tells you a piece of private news about a friend and adds that everyone will hear it soon anyway, so you might as well pass it on. What is the kindest choice?

options.text: Keep it to yourself, since it is your friend's news to share, not yours
Share it only with one trusted person and swear them to secrecy
Post a vague hint so people can guess for themselves
Tell your friend who started spreading it and every detail you heard

explanation: Private news belongs to the person it is about, even when others are already gossiping; not passing it on keeps you trustworthy.
